text:
dana (AE): FYI Polaris Dynamics just returned our SOW with two hard blockers: 1) they want a 99.95% SLA for Dedicated from day 1, 2) strict egress allowlist + per-tenant firewall rules, and 3) they insist on HSM attestation or signed third-party letter. Procurement also asked if we can do a 12-month commit at 20% below standard reserved price. Need triage.
sahil (Solutions Eng): A 99.95% SLA on day 1 for a new dedicated pool is tough. We can commit to operational targets and an SLA once pool warms up (30d). Can we propose a staged SLA ramp: 99.5% first 30 days -> 99.95% after acceptance? Also need their expected qps and burst.
dana (AE): They said initial pilot: 1k sustained req/s, 3k burst, 128-token avg. They want autoscale to hit that load inside 48 hours of go-live.
emma (Security): HSM attestation is non-trivial. We don't issue new attestation letters ad-hoc. Options: (A) provide SOC2 + KMS integration docs + signed controls statement; (B) offer a roadmap + checkpoint dates for HSM attestation and include it in contract as a deliverable with milestone. If procurement requires attestation up front, escalate to legal.
ravi (Legal): We can add a deliverable in the SOW for attestation with a timeline, but can't guarantee third-party attestation within contract signing unless terms pass legal review. Need to review indemnity/penalty language if they make SLA conditional on attestation.
caroline (VP Sales): Pricing concession request for 12mo at 20% needs exec approval. If they're strategic, we can consider a blend: 9mo commit + committed burst credits + usage-based overage. Also mark that 99.95% day-1 SLA + attestation up-front is high-risk.
sahil (Solutions Eng): Technical notes: we can ship per-tenant firewall rules via our Dedicated VPC templates and route tables. Egress allowlist: need their CIDRs and any partner endpoints. Autoscale: we can provide an autoscale policy. Example snippet to include in runbook:
```
autoscale:
  target_cpu: 70
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 40
  scale_window: 60s
  warmup: 120s
```
This supports 3k burst with pre-warming; but real numbers depend on model quantization and batch size.
emma (Security): Two immediate asks from security team: 1) confirm KMS BYOK flow + rotation policy (they want rotation frequency), 2) require clarity on audit log retention and access (how long logs are kept and how they can be exported).
dana (AE): I'll ask Polaris for CIDRs and confirm rotation cadence they expect. Also pushing back on attestation ask with the staged attestation plan.
infra-bot: Ticket created: PD-7901 "Polaris Dedicated onboarding - SLA/Attestation triage" (assignee: sahil).
sahil (Solutions Eng): I'll own a technical response draft by EOD today. I'll include VPC template, autoscale snippet, and a proposed SLA ramp.
caroline (VP Sales): Caroline here: If procurement insists on 20% off for 12mo + day-1 99.95% SLA we need an exec review. Marking this as "exec-approval-needed". Dana please add bullet on strategic value in the reply.
dana (AE): Will do. Quick draft for procurement to soften them: "We propose a staged production acceptance: initial stability period with operational targets, followed by a certification window after which the full SLA and attestation commitments take effect." Thoughts?
emma (Security): Sounds good. Add: "Security deliverables available at contract signing: SOC2, KMS integration docs, audit log export process. HSM attestation included as a milestone in SOW with checkpoint dates."
ravi (Legal): I'll prep language for SOW milestone and review penalty/credit wording for SLA ramp. Also need to confirm whether we can commit to defined uptime credits for partial misses during ramp.
sahil (Solutions Eng): One more technical item — network failover: if their egress blocks our cross-region failover, we should call that out as a limitation to SLA. Include this line in runbook: "SLA contingent on cross-region network egress allowances as defined in Section 3."
dana (AE): Great. Meeting request: Polaris asked for an internal technical bridge before the customer call. Can we do a quick sync 2pm PT today? Sahil/Emma/Ravi/Caroline?
caroline (VP Sales): 2pm PT OK for me.
sahil (Solutions Eng): I can join at 2pm.
emma (Security): I'll join 2pm.
ravi (Legal): I'll try to join or review notes after.
dana (AE): Scheduler invite sent. Action items summary:
- sahil: technical response + runbook draft + PD-7901 updates by EOD (includes autoscale, VPC template, SLA ramp)
- emma: security deliverables checklist & proposed attestation milestone language by EOD
- ravi: SOW milestone language and SLA credit options by EOD
- caroline: confirm exec approval path for pricing concession
- dana: collect CIDRs and rotation cadence from Polaris, send initial soft reply.
caroline (VP Sales): If procurement escalates, I'll open an exec bridge. Keep updates in PD-7901 and ping me. :thumbsup:
dana (AE): Thanks all — I'll post the Polaris procurement reply after the 2pm internal sync and attach PD-7901 link.
